name: Samophlange Manual
summary: In Orgrimmar, Rilli Greasygob needs help with a broken samophlange. The goblin engineer sends you back into the Barrens for the operating instructions, held by his former Venture Company rival.

sections.title: Corporate Rivalries and Trade Secrets
sections.body: Rilli Greasygob once worked beside Boss Copperplug in the Venture Company. Copperplug oversaw the samophlange’s inner workings and guarded their secrets closely. He shared no manual with Rilli. Instead, he gave out separate pages only to underlings he trusted, leaving his fellow engineer without the knowledge to understand the device.

sections.title: Infiltration of Boulder Lode
sections.body: Rilli sends you to Boulder Lode Mine in the northeastern Barrens to find the instructions for the contraption brought from there. Boss Copperplug is somewhere in the mine, and pages he handed out are scattered among its operations. You need to gather them and piece together a complete guide to repairing the device.

faq.answer: The Samophlange Manual explains the device’s mechanics and how to repair it. The Venture Company uses the complex, eccentric machine.
Boss Copperplug oversees the Venture Company’s Boulder Lode Mine in the northeastern Barrens. He once rivaled Rilli Greasygob and kept the samophlange’s operating secrets and manual pages to himself.

faq.q: Where is the Boulder Lode Mine located?
faq.answer: Boulder Lode Mine lies in the northeastern Barrens, north of the Crossroads and west of the coast.

faq.q: Why does Rilli Greasygob need the manual?
faq.answer: Rilli believes he can repair and operate the broken samophlange brought from the Barrens, but its convoluted design calls for the official instructions.

faq.q: How does Sputtervalve fit into this task?
faq.answer: Sputtervalve is an associate in Ratchet who first sought information about the device and stays in touch with Rilli. Sputtervalve sends thanks and compensation for obtaining the machine’s schematics.

faq.q: What happens after the manual is returned?
faq.answer: Rilli eagerly studies the manual, hoping to get the machine working. Repairing such an arcane contraption remains an ongoing mechanical puzzle.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can appreciate how goblins guard corporate inventions: they tear complex schematics apart and hoard the pieces so colleagues cannot copy them.
As a member of the Horde, you help goblin specialists in Orgrimmar secure valuable technical salvage and strike back at the Venture Company’s predatory operations nearby.
